title: Your First Shiny App
text:
Today you build Milestone M2. Reading: Moraga Ch. 13–14.

M2 — Reactive app Shiny reactivity: the user selects a region and a time period — a dropdown, a slider, or an animation — and the maps and summaries respond.

Your M1 dashboard shows all 21 years and the one county you chose. M2 hands both choices to the reader. Two small apps first, to see how Shiny thinks; then the M1 dashboard, with a dropdown and a slider.
